baseline.missing.why: No Baseline exists for this project, so there is nothing to compare against. Capture one first.
baseline.missing.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

baseline.unavailable.why: The saved copy of the project that the Baseline needs is not available, so this cannot be measured. Take a fresh Baseline.
baseline.unavailable.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

project.busy.why: Another Motif task holds this project, so it cannot be used yet. Wait about ten seconds.
project.busy.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

project.in-use.why: FieldWorks has the project open, so Motif cannot change it. Ask the linguist to save and close it, then repeat this call.
project.in-use.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

project.registration-failed.why: Motif could not record the project because the worker root at {workerRoot} or the machine store at {machineStorePath} is not writable or valid. Fix them, or let any other writer to the store finish.
project.registration-failed.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

change.project-saving.why: FieldWorks is saving the project, so it cannot be changed this moment. Wait a few seconds.
change.project-saving.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

project.not-found.why: The project file is missing, so there is nothing to open. Tell the linguist; do not guess another path.
project.not-found.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

job.wait-timeout.why: The job is still running, so its result is not ready. Keep waiting.
job.wait-timeout.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

job.wait-cancelled.why: The wait was cancelled before the job finished. Wait again.
job.wait-cancelled.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

proposal.not-found.why: No Proposal has that id, so it cannot be used. List the Proposals that exist, then use one of those ids.
proposal.not-found.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

proposal.invalid-id.why: That is not a well-formed Proposal id, so it cannot be looked up. Use a proposalId a tool returned, or one from the Proposal list; do not type one.
proposal.invalid-id.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

draft.revision-conflict.why: The Draft changed after you last read it, so this change would overwrite newer work. Read the Draft again with its id, then retry.
draft.revision-conflict.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

job.dry-run-incomplete.why: The Dry Run did not complete, so the Draft has not been checked. Revise the Draft and run a new Dry Run.
job.dry-run-incomplete.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

store.other-version.why: Motif's data for this project was made by another version of Motif, so this version cannot read it. Tell the linguist; do not retry.
store.other-version.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

parse.already-running.why: A parse is already running for this project, so a second cannot start. Wait a minute.
parse.already-running.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

assess.parser-memory-limit.why: The parser used more memory than Motif allows, so the run was stopped. Tell the linguist; do not retry unchanged.
assess.parser-memory-limit.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

assess.parser-unavailable.why: The parser is not installed here, so words cannot be assessed. Tell the linguist; evaluation tools cannot run.
assess.parser-unavailable.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

grammarcheck.parser-unavailable.why: The parser is not installed here, so the grammar cannot be checked. Tell the linguist; evaluation tools cannot run.
grammarcheck.parser-unavailable.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

project.writing-system-missing.why: A writing system the project needs is not set up here. This is a setup problem, not damaged data; tell the linguist what the message says to fix, and do not retry unchanged.
project.writing-system-missing.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

tool.unknown-argument.why: The call named an argument this tool does not have, so it was not run. Remove the argument the message names, or check the tool's input schema.
tool.unknown-argument.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

tool.missing-argument.why: The call left out an argument this tool requires, so it was not run. Add the argument the message names.
tool.missing-argument.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

tool.failed.why: The tool failed unexpectedly; the diagnostic log has 'tool {toolName} failed'. If it fails again after one repeat, stop and tell the linguist.
tool.failed.source: Hand-written from the Motif MCP refusal advice.

composer.goal-or-subject.why: A composer search needs exactly one of a goal or a Subject. Give a goal in a few words to rank composers, or a Subject id to list every composer that serves it.

composer.invalid-detail.why: The detail level must be concise or detailed. Leave it out for concise.

composer-no-match.why: Motif has no Composer for "{goal}" yet; the nearest Subject is {subject}.
composer-no-match.source: Hand-written for the composer search; {goal} and {subject} are filled in.

composer-no-match-no-subject.why: Motif has no Composer for "{goal}" yet.
composer-no-match-no-subject.source: Hand-written for the composer search; {goal} is filled in.

composer-no-match-next.why: Tell the person what is missing, in these words: {missing} Do not stage a nearby Composer as a stand-in for it.
composer-no-match-next.source: Hand-written for the composer search; {missing} is the sentence above.

composer.unknown-subject.why: No composer serves that Subject. Search by goal to find the right composer, or use one of the Subject ids the search lists.
